name_vi: Túi cuối tuần đáy mở rộng
description_en: A wide trapezoidal woven travel bag with leather base, expandable textile zipper gusset and twin handles. Canonical front: a broad trapezoidal face crossed by two handle straps. Side view: a folded expansion gusset above the leather base. Rear view: a woven back panel with a trolley-handle sleeve. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: A wide trapezoidal woven travel bag with leather base, expandable textile zipper gusset and twin handles. Canonical front: a broad trapezoidal face crossed by two handle straps. Side view: a folded expansion gusset above the leather base. Rear view: a woven back panel with a trolley-handle sleeve. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Rustic: sturdy handmade character and visible bindings. Relative size medium within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: cinnabar red lacquer retaining clearly visible woven strip intersections. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
